verdicts.reason: A is just a shrunk copy shifted down: there is a big empty band above the logo and about 150px of dead space at the bottom, all the type is smaller than it needs to be (the pills and the URL line are tiny), and the oversized circle crowds the logo. B keeps the headline and RSVP button larger and fills the height better, but the tag pills have drifted away from the date and venue block so they sit closer to the CTA than to their details, there is a gap under the can, and the missing-asset partner box is jammed into the bottom-right corner.
